title: Read-only role check blames the role for any change to the shared tree

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Observed 2026-11-11 (slicer wave 2): `ork wave start slicer s455 s450 s456 s451 s453` failed with "ork: spec check failed: spec-check changed the tree, and it is a read-only role". The change was another session filing slicer s459 on main (log entry 19:18:46, from ork's S335 spec work), not the spec check. Wanted: compare only paths the role could have written, or name the changed paths and their log origin in the error, and refuse to start a spec check on a dirty tree rather than failing after it.
